settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage your account and company preferences

settings.billingDescription: Manage the recurring SaaS billing subscription, invoices, and entitlement state.
settings.billingPermission: Only owner or admin users can manage billing.
settings.annualBalanceDescription: Send a manual year-end or as-of-date balance confirmation. The backend calculates whether the counterparty owes you, you owe them, or the balance is settled.
settings.annualBalanceHelp: The sent email includes one-click links for Confirm balance and Report mismatch. Those clicks are recorded in annual balance history.
settings.reminderAutomationDescription: Run the general reminder cron every weekday. Each tenant decides which weekday is valid, how often reminders may repeat, and how many overdue days must pass first.
settings.missingReceiptRemindersDescription: Automatically send reminders for outgoing bank payments that have no matching purchase invoice.
settings.receiptResponsibleEmailHint: Person to notify when a receipt is missing for this {entity}
settings.draftExclusionRulesDescription: On bank import, no draft purchase invoice is auto-created for these outgoing payments (e.g. EMTA, bank fees). Rules are pre-seeded and editable.
settings.cronAutomationHelp: Cron automation endpoint: POST /api/billing/jobs/send-reminders-all with x-cron-secret. Run it every weekday; tenant weekday and frequency settings are applied in the backend.
settings.subscriptionDescription: One recurring subscription per tenant in the current MVP.
settings.loadPreviewHint: Load a reminder or annual balance preview to inspect the rendered text before sending.
settings.subject: Subject
settings.annualBalanceReportingDescription: Report, review, and export annual balance confirmations and responses for a selected period.
settings.loadPeriodForAnnualBalance: Load a period to view annual balance report data.
settings.reminderOperationsDescription: Operational queue for overdue billing invoices, reminder eligibility, and follow-up timing.
settings.noReminderOperations: No open billing invoices eligible for reminder operations.
settings.reminderSkippedNoRecipient: Reminder skipped because no billing recipient email is configured.
settings.reminderSkippedDisabled: Reminder skipped because reminders are disabled.
settings.reminderSkippedNotOverdueEnough: Reminder skipped because the invoice is not overdue long enough yet.
settings.reminderSkippedFrequency: Reminder skipped because the reminder frequency is not reached yet.
settings.reminderSkippedWeekdayMismatch: Reminder skipped because today does not match the configured reminder weekday.
settings.internalNotificationDescription: Latest internal alerts sent when customers report annual balance mismatches.
settings.noInternalNotifications: No internal annual balance notifications recorded.
settings.annualBalanceMismatchDescription: All reported balance issues are collected here so they can be reviewed from one place.
settings.mismatchWeOwe: Mismatch on balance where we owe {amount} EUR
settings.mismatchTheyOwe: Mismatch on balance where they owe {amount} EUR
settings.noAnnualBalanceHistory: No annual balance confirmations sent yet.
settings.businessRegistryDescription: Configure the backend-only Estonian Business Registry integration. Credentials remain masked after save.
settings.businessRegistryPermission: Only owner or admin users can manage Business Registry integration settings.
settings.integrationsDescription: Import sales invoices via the Futursoft/Autifutur API. Invoices are posted to accounting automatically. The sync runs when you open the sales invoices view (at most once per hour) and via the manual button.
settings.futursoftConfigureAccountsWarning: Before enabling, configure default sales accounts (per supply type) and make sure invoice dates fall in an open period — otherwise invoices cannot be posted automatically.
settings.futursoftEnabledDescription: Turns the Futursoft sales invoice import on or off.
settings.futursoftAutoPostDescription: Off: imported invoices stay as drafts awaiting your confirmation. On: invoices are confirmed and posted to the ledger as they are imported.
settings.leaveBlankKeepApiKey: Leave blank to keep the stored key
settings.futursoftStartDateHint: The initial import starts from this date. Leave blank to use the sync window. Changing the date re-runs the import from it (already-imported invoices are skipped).
settings.futursoftPostingHint: Define how imported invoice lines map to accounts and whether lines are aggregated.
settings.futursoftRulesHint: Rules apply in order: product code → goods/service. With no match, the supply-type default account is used.
settings.futursoftNoRules: No rules. Supply-type default accounts are used.
settings.meritPalkDescription: Import the month's payroll journal from Merit Palk: wage cost, social tax, withheld income tax, unemployment insurance and pension.
settings.meritPalkEnabledDescription: Allows importing the payroll journal through the Merit Palk API.
settings.meritPalkAutoPostDescription: When off, the month is imported but the entry waits for an accountant to confirm it.
settings.meritPalkApiKeyHint: Create it in Merit Palk: Settings → API settings. Leave blank to keep the stored key.
settings.meritPalkAccountMapHint: Merit Palk's chart codes must be mapped to Arvelo accounts. An unmapped code stops the month's import — no partial entry is created.
settings.meritPalkImportSkipped: Import skipped — already running, or there was nothing to import.
settings.meritPalkNoCodes: No codes read yet. Pick a month and press "Read the month's codes".
settings.meritPalkTaxLiabilityHint: Tick the rows that make up the payment to the tax board — they are what prefills the bank transaction split.
settings.futursoftDiscoverHint: Loads invoices for the selected period and lists the unique product codes so you can map them straight to sales accounts — no need to type codes by hand. Imports nothing.
settings.futursoftDiscoverEmpty: No product codes found in this period.
settings.futursoftBaseAccountsHint: Base mapping. Used when a product code has no specific rule.
settings.futursoftByTypeNote: In 'goods and services separate' mode the mapping above is enough — no code loading needed.
settings.futursoftImportSkipped: Import skipped (already running or run too recently).
settings.integrationEnabledDescription: Turns authenticated registry lookup on or off.
settings.leaveBlankKeepUsername: Leave blank to keep existing username
settings.leaveBlankKeepPassword: Leave blank to keep existing password
settings.openingBalancesImported: Opening balances have been imported ({count} batch(es)). You can reset (deletes all journal entries) and re-import opening balances. Reset is available for 3 months after the import.
settings.noOpeningBalancesImported: No opening balances have been imported yet.
settings.systemRolesDescription: Choose which accounts fulfil the system roles (receivables, payables, bank, VAT, sales, purchase). Invoicing, banking and VAT post to these accounts.
settings.vatRegisteredHint: If the company is not VAT registered, sales invoices are issued without VAT.
settings.createDefaultChartHint: No accounts yet. Create our default chart of accounts (good for a fresh company) or import your own chart.
settings.resetHistoryDescription: Previous opening balance resets with backups that can be restored.
settings.resetOpeningBalancesDescription: This will PERMANENTLY DELETE ALL journal entries (not just opening balances) and delete invoices created automatically during the opening balance import. You can then re-import opening balances. This action cannot be undone.
settings.resetDeleteAccounts: Also delete the chart of accounts
settings.resetWindowExpired: Reset is no longer available — opening balances were imported more than {months} months ago. Reset is intended for correcting opening balances right after import.
settings.restoreOpeningBalancesDescription: This will re-commit the opening balances from this backup. Are you sure?
settings.openingBalancesResetSuccess: Data reset successfully. Deleted {entries} entr(ies){invoices, plural, =0 {} other {, # invoice(s)}}{accounts, plural, =0 {} other {, # account(s)}}{partners, plural, =0 {} other {, # partner(s)}} ({count} opening balance batch(es)).
settings.openingBalancesRestoredSuccess: Opening balances restored successfully. {count} batch(es) re-committed.
settings.inviteExistingHint: The user must already have an Arvelo account. They will be added to this tenant immediately.
settings.createUserHint: Creates a new user and adds them to this tenant. The user can log in right away with the password you set.
settings.removeMemberConfirm: Remove {name} from this tenant? They will lose access immediately.
settings.bankGatewaysDescription: Connect LHV Connect and Swedbank Gateway to import bank statements automatically and send e-invoices.
settings.bankGatewaySyncSkipped: Sync skipped: a sync is already running or the connection is disabled.
settings.bankGatewaySyncPending: Statement requested from the bank ({requested} account(s)). The response arrives shortly — run sync again in a minute.
settings.bankGatewaySyncDone: Sync finished: {jobs} statement(s) fetched, {imported} transaction(s) imported.
settings.bankGatewayLhvDescription: Automatic account statements over the LHV Connect API.
settings.bankGatewaySwedbankDescription: Automatic account statements and e-invoice sending over Swedbank Gateway (e-invoices reach all Estonian banks).
settings.bankGatewayCertHint: The platform certificate for this bank is not configured yet. The connection can be saved, but syncing requires the operator to install the bank certificate.
settings.bankGatewayEnabledDescription: Fetch statements for this company through this bank connection.
settings.bankGatewayAutoCommitDescription: Commit statement rows automatically when nothing needs review; flagged rows always wait for approval.
settings.bankGatewayClientCodeHint: Sent as the Client-Code header — identifies this company under the platform’s LHV Connect agreement.
settings.bankGatewayAgreementIdHint: The company’s Swedbank Gateway agreement number (from the agreement concluded in Swedbank Internet Bank).
settings.bankGatewayEinvoiceAgreementIdHint: Required for sending e-invoices; from the e-invoice seller agreement with Swedbank.
settings.bankGatewayStartDateHint: First statement day for the initial backfill; leave empty to use the sync window.
settings.bankGatewayContractIntro: Conclude the LHV Connect agreement directly from here: we create a pending contract at LHV and the bank emails the signing container to your company’s representative. LHV activates the contract after signing.
settings.bankGatewayContractStarted: LHV agreement started. The signing container was emailed to your representative — you can also download it below.
settings.bankGatewayContractSignHint: Waiting for signature and LHV activation. Your company’s representative received the signing container by email; after signing, LHV Client Services activates the contract.
settings.inviteUserHint: Enter an email and role. If the person already has an Arvelo account they are added immediately; otherwise they receive an email invitation to set their own password. The invite link is valid for 7 days.
settings.cancelInviteConfirm: Cancel the invitation sent to {email}? The emailed link will stop working.
settings.inviteEmailFailed: Invite for {email} was saved, but the email could not be sent. Check the mail settings and use resend.

assistant.intro: Ask how to do something in Arvelo, or ask me to do it for you — for example add a bank account or a product. I show every change on a card first, and nothing changes until you press “Confirm”.
assistant.expired: This proposal has expired. Ask the assistant to make it again.

paymentMethods.title: Payment methods
paymentMethods.description: How customers pay (cash, card, web shop, bank transfer) and which account the money lands on. You pick a method when you register a receipt or payment on an invoice.
paymentMethods.empty: No payment methods yet. Without one, manually registered payments are posted to the default bank account.
paymentMethods.name: Name
paymentMethods.accountHint: Cash → cash desk. Card and online payments → a clearing account the payment provider later settles to the bank. Only asset accounts can be chosen.
paymentMethods.noMethodsHint: No payment methods — the payment goes to the default bank account.
paymentMethods.payoutDescription: When the payment provider pays out to your bank, Arvelo recognises the payout, links it to the card payments and posts the fee (receipts − bank amount) to expenses automatically.
paymentMethods.payoutHint: Identifier = a word in the counterparty name or description on the bank statement (several separated by commas). The expected fee picks the right payments; when it matches, bulk auto-match posts the payout too.
paymentMethods.payoutNotSet: Automatic payout posting not set up

cash.subtitle: Cash movements as cash orders and the cash book with a running balance.

cash.addDesk: Add a cash desk in settings
cash.assistantSetupPrompt: Set up a cash desk for me: add a payment method “Cash desk” of type cash and link it to the cash account.
cash.wentNegative: The cash balance went negative during the period — check the order dates.

expenseReports.title: Expense reports

expenseReports.willCreateEmployee: If the name isn't listed, “{name}” is added as a new partner.
expenseReports.confirmDelete: Delete this expense report and its receipts?
expenseReports.confirmApprove: Approve the expense report of {total} €? The receipts are posted and the amount becomes owed to the employee.
expenseReports.owedHint: The employee's balance on the accountable persons account across all expense reports.
expenseReports.receiptHint: The amount is the receipt total including VAT; net and VAT follow from the rate. Each receipt is stored as a purchase invoice, so its input VAT reaches the VAT return.
expenseReports.reimburseHint: Reimburse from the bank: in bank review choose “Post to account”, account {account} and partner {employee}. Or pay from the cash desk with “Pay from cash desk”.

access.title: Employee self-service
access.intro: The employee enters expense reports and receipts on their phone. They get an e-mail invite with no password: they sign in with an e-mailed link, and a passkey is offered on the phone. They cannot see the books.
access.noMatches: Not found. Add the employee as a partner first.
access.invited: Invite sent to {email}. It is valid for 7 days.
access.inviteNotSent: The invite was created but the e-mail could not be sent. Try resending.
access.linked: {email} is already a user of the company: they were linked to this employee and see their expense reports in self-service.

approval.title: Expense report approvers
approval.approversHint: If nobody is selected, all accountants, admins and the owner can approve.
approval.notifyHint: An e-mail when an employee submits an expense report. If nobody is selected, the approvers are notified.
approval.readOnly: The owner and admins can change the approvers.
approval.notApprover: Only the designated approvers can approve expense reports

rikEinvoice.title: E-invoices (RIK e-Financials)
rikEinvoice.description: Sales invoices go as e-invoices straight into the buyer's accounting software, and suppliers can send e-invoices to you. Arvelo forwards e-invoices through the Estonian Centre of Registers and Information Systems (RIK).
rikEinvoice.serverNotConfigured: E-invoicing through RIK is not yet set up on this server (Arvelo's RIK interface keys are missing). Contact support.
rikEinvoice.receiveHint: For receiving, confirm RIK as your e-invoice receiver in the business portal (ettevotjaportaal.rik.ee) within 7 days. Incoming e-invoices become purchase invoice drafts with the source “E-invoice”.
rikEinvoice.enabledReceive: Sending and receiving e-invoices is on. Confirm RIK as your receiver in the business portal.
rikEinvoice.disabled: E-invoices through RIK are turned off.
rikEinvoice.received: Created {created} new purchase invoice drafts ({skipped} already existed).

rikEinvoice.connectionOk: Connection works ({env}): {count} forwarding contracts at RIK, none yet for this company.
rikEinvoice.connectionOkWithContract: Connection works ({env}) and this company's forwarding contract exists at RIK.

startup.title: Startup bookkeeping
startup.subtitle: No bookkeeping so far? Reconstruct the current year from the bank statement: AI suggests an account for every transaction, you confirm.
startup.step1Body: The founding date decides where the books start. Details are prefilled from the business registry when available.
startup.registryFailed: Business registry lookup failed ({error}). Enter the details manually.
startup.registryPrefilled: Founding date and share capital come from the business registry — please check them.
startup.capitalPaid: paid in (the deposit is on the bank statement)
startup.scenarioThisYear: The company was founded this financial year: there is no previous period. The only opening item is share capital; everything since founding is reconstructed from the bank statement.
startup.scenarioEarlier: The company was founded earlier: the previous year-end balance sheet (annual report) is needed as the opening balance. The current year (from {date}) is reconstructed from the bank statement.
startup.aiConsent: Allow sending bank transaction data (counterparty, amount, description) to AI for account suggestions.
startup.aiConsentHint: Using {provider} ({model}). No personal codes or balances are sent; the accountant confirms every suggestion.
startup.aiNotConfigured: AI is not configured on the server (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY missing).
startup.aiNotEnabled: AI suggestions are turned off — enable them in the setup.
startup.savedNotice: Saved. The books start on {date}; periods are created.
startup.capitalEntryPosted: The unpaid share capital entry was posted.
startup.periodErrors: {count} periods could not be created — check the fiscal year settings.
startup.step2Body: Import the balance sheet of the previous annual report (PDF or Excel). Without a report, enter the bank balance and owner loan/capital manually.
startup.step3Body: Import statements of every bank account from {date} (camt.053 or CSV). The statement opening balance must equal the bank account balance in the books.
startup.statementStartsLate: The statement starts after the books — import the earlier period too.
startup.openingMismatch: Opening balances do not match. Does the statement start at founding? Is the previous year-end imported?
startup.step4Body: AI groups transactions by counterparty and suggests an account. Confirm confident suggestions in bulk, review the rest one by one.
startup.checkOpening: Statement opening = balance in the books
startup.checkClosing: Statement closing = balance in the books today
startup.checkMissingReceiptsDetail: Attach an invoice or receipt to each draft; without one, input VAT cannot be deducted.
startup.ready: Done — the current year is reconstructed.
startup.notReady: Not done yet — see the flagged items above.
startup.essentialsTitle: What the bank statement does not show — startup checklist
startup.essentialCapital: Share capital: paid in (deposit in the bank → 2900) or unpaid (2905 / 2900)?
startup.essentialOwnerPaid: Founding costs and expenses the owner paid personally (state fee, notary, domain, receipts): book them as an expense report — the company owes the owner.
startup.essentialFirstYear: The first financial year may last up to 18 months; the annual report is due within 6 months after year-end.
startup.essentialVat: VAT: mandatory registration above 40,000 € turnover. Input VAT is deductible only with an invoice; the VAT return is built from invoices.
startup.essentialTaxes: Payments to the Tax Board go to the prepaid tax account; paying salaries requires a TSD return.
startup.essentialOwner: Owner withdrawals are a dividend, a loan to the shareholder or a fringe benefit — each with its own tax consequence. AI only flags them; the accountant decides.
startup.essentialDocuments: Every entry needs a source document. Missing receipts stay on the missing documents list until attached.
startup.essentialUnpaid: Unpaid invoices (receivables and payables) do not show in the bank — add them separately.
startup.reconstructIntro: Unposted bank transactions from {date}, grouped by counterparty.
startup.footerHint: Drafts wait for a document; match skipped transactions to invoices in the review tab.
startup.applyNeedsAccount: Every group being posted needs an account.
startup.notSetUpTitle: Startup bookkeeping is not set up
startup.notSetUpBody: Fill in the company details and enable AI suggestions before reconstructing transactions.

invoiceInbox.description: Your company’s own e-mail address for purchase invoices. PDF and e-invoice (XML) attachments sent there become purchase invoice drafts, just like an upload.

invoiceInbox.howTo: Give this address to suppliers or forward invoices here from your mailbox. Attachments (PDF, e-invoice XML) are recognised and become purchase invoice drafts; the supplier is matched by the sender and the invoice data.
invoiceInbox.disabledWithAddress: Receiving is turned off. Mail sent to {address} is not accepted.
invoiceInbox.notEnabled: Turn it on to get your company’s address for invoices.
invoiceInbox.logEmpty: No e-mail has arrived at this address yet.
invoiceInbox.rotateDescription: Your company gets a new address and mail sent to the old one is no longer accepted. Tell your suppliers the new address.

selfService.confirmSubmit: Submit the expense report of {total} €? After submitting only the accountant can change it.
selfService.confirmDelete: Delete this expense report with its receipts?

statusHint.submitted: Submitted. The accountant will review and approve it.
statusHint.approved: Approved. The amount will be reimbursed to you.

selfService.takePhoto: Take a photo of the receipt
selfService.amountHint: Enter the receipt total including VAT.
selfService.passkeyTitle: Sign in with one tap next time
selfService.passkeyText: Add a passkey and sign in with your fingerprint or face, without an e-mail link.

payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.subtitle: Monthly payroll, taxes, journal entry, payouts and the data-based TSD.
payroll.newRunHint: The draft includes everyone whose contract is in force in the chosen month. Amounts can be changed before approval.
payroll.paymentDateHint: Leave empty for next month's pay day from settings. The TSD is filed by the payment month.
payroll.emptyRunsHint: Add employees and their contracts first, then create the month's payroll.

tsd.title: Data-based TSD
tsd.hint: The file contains every posted payroll run paid out in the chosen month (XBRL GL, section EE0201001).
tsd.uploadHint: Upload the file in the e-MTA TSD payroll payments view, check the totals there and confirm the declaration.
tsd.downloaded: TSD file ({period}) downloaded. Upload it to e-MTA.
tsd.formatXbrlHint: EMTA's new format: every payment (date + type) is its own entry.
tsd.formatXbrlMonthlyHint: All of a person's payments of one type in the month as one entry (dated with the last payment).
tsd.formatCsvHint: One row per person and type. e-MTA accepts this format until the end of 2027.
tsd.includeSentHint: By default entries already in an earlier file are left out — e-MTA does not accept the same entry as new again.

payroll.employeesSubtitle: Employees, board members and service providers who are paid a fee.
payroll.name: Name
payroll.newPartnerHint: Pick an existing partner or type a new name — the partner is created automatically.
payroll.personalCodeKeep: A personal code is stored. Leave empty to keep it.
payroll.applyExemption: The employee has applied for the basic exemption
payroll.pensionAgeHint: Higher exemption, no employee unemployment premium, no social tax minimum.
payroll.applyMinSocialTaxHint: For employment contracts social tax is paid on at least the monthly rate, except in the cases set out in the law.
payroll.applyMinSocialTaxLineHint: Turn off if an exception under the Social Tax Act applies this month (see EMTA guidance).

warning.noPersonalCode: Personal code missing — the TSD cannot be built
warning.runNoPersonalCode: {name}: personal code missing — the TSD cannot be built.
warning.runNoIban: {name}: IBAN missing — the payment cannot be created.
warning.partialMonth: {name}: the contract started or ended during the month — check the salary and the social tax minimum.
warning.vacationUnpaid: {name}: holiday starts {date}, holiday pay not yet paid (paid separately before the leave).
warning.sickManual: {name}: sick leave {date} is a special case (work accident, pregnancy etc.) — enter the benefit by hand.

payroll.cancelHint: The payroll run is cancelled. A new one can be created for the same month.
payroll.cancelPostedHint: A storno entry reverses the posted payroll. If the TSD was already filed, download the TSD cancellation file afterwards and upload it to e-MTA.
payroll.paymentsHint: Each employee's net pay to their IBAN. The batch appears under Payment batches, where you can send it to the bank or download the file.
payroll.includeTaxes: Add taxes to the Tax and Customs Board
payroll.includeTaxesHint: Uses the prepayment reference number from settings.
payroll.paymentsCreated: Payment batch created — see Bank → Payment batches.
payroll.editHint: Click a line to add a bonus, holiday pay or sick pay, or to change amounts.
payroll.itemsHint: Amounts are gross. Sick pay paid by the employer is declared separately (payment type 24) and only income tax is withheld from it.
payroll.noContractsToAdd: Every contract is already in the run. Add a new contract on the employee:
payroll.settingsSubtitle: Posting accounts, pay day and the tax payment reference.
payroll.paymentDayHint: Default payment day in the following month for a new run.
payroll.emtaReferenceHint: The company's personal reference number in e-MTA (for paying taxes).
payroll.postingAccountsHint: When empty, the standard chart account with the same code is used.
payroll.accountMissing: Account {code} is not in the chart — choose an account.
payroll.employerPaid: The employer also paid {social} € social tax and {ui} € unemployment insurance.
payroll.absencesSubtitle: Holidays, sick leave and unpaid leave. They drive the monthly salary, holiday pay and sick pay.
payroll.refreshAbsencesHint: Recalculates base salary, holiday pay and sick pay from the absences. Items added by hand are kept.
payroll.autoItem: Calculated from the contract and absences

leave.title: Holiday balance
leave.openingHint: Unused days as of a date (e.g. when moving from another payroll system).

absence.locked: This absence is already paid in an approved or posted payroll run. Cancel that run to change it.
absence.timingHint: By law holiday pay is paid before the leave unless agreed otherwise.
absence.timingDefaultHint: Default for a new holiday; can be changed per holiday.
absence.sickManual: Enter the special-case sick pay by hand in the payroll run.
absence.listHint: Adding an absence updates the payroll draft of that month automatically.

payroll.contractsInForce: {count, plural, one {# contract is in force this month} other {# contracts are in force this month}}: {names}
payroll.noContractsInMonth: No contract is in force this month — choose a month when a contract runs, or check the contract start.
payroll.noContractsAtAll: No employees with a contract yet — add them first:
payroll.noLinesHint: No contract was in force in the work month. Add one with “Add contract”, or delete the draft and choose the right month.

tsdManual.title: TSD for manual entry
tsdManual.subtitle: The payout month summed per person and payment type — the same rows that go into e-MTA. Click a value to copy it.
tsdManual.empty: No posted payroll is paid out in this month.
tsdManual.how1: Open the TSD payroll payments view in e-MTA and choose the same payout month.
tsdManual.how2: For each row add the personal code, payment type and amount; tax-free income and the social tax top-up when filled.
tsdManual.how3: Compare e-MTA's tax amounts with this table and confirm the declaration.
tsdManual.summaryNote: {payments} payments, {rows} rows after summing per person and type.

leaveRequest.title: Leave
leaveRequest.overBalance: The application exceeds the holiday balance — the bookkeeper may still approve it.
leaveRequest.timingBeforeHint: Holiday pay is paid to you before the leave starts.
leaveRequest.timingWithSalaryHint: Holiday pay is paid with your next salary.
leaveRequest.pendingTitle: {count, plural, one {# leave application waiting} other {# leave applications waiting}}
leaveRequest.notApprover: You are not a leave approver
leaveRequest.approversHint: With nobody chosen, every owner, admin and accountant can approve. Approvers get an e-mail about a new application.

demo.title: Try Arvelo as a bureau
demo.subtitle: You get your own demo: an accounting bureau and four sample clients with realistic data. No account or card needed.

points.clients: Four client companies: a busy construction firm, a café, a dormant holding and a non-profit
points.oneLogin: One sign-in — switch between companies with one click
points.safe: Nothing goes out: e-mails, e-invoices and bank payments are off in the demo
points.duration: The demo lasts 14 days and is then deleted completely

demo.wait: Setting up the demo takes about half a minute.
demo.expired: Your previous demo has expired and was deleted. You can start a new one.
demo.banner: Demo environment: sample data, no e-mails or e-invoices are sent. Available until {date}.
demo.bannerNoDate: Demo environment: sample data, no e-mails or e-invoices are sent.

migration.title: Migration
migration.subtitle: Move the company's bookkeeping from the previous software into Arvelo. Each step says what to export from the old software and where to load it in Arvelo.

company.title: Company details
company.body: Check that the registry code, VAT number and address are right — they go on invoices, VAT returns and reports.

strategy.title: Transition
strategy.body: Choose where the books in Arvelo start. It decides which reports you need from the old software.

with_general.title: From the start of the year
with_general.body: Last year's closing balance sheet and open invoices. The simplest way.

mid_year.title: Mid-year
mid_year.body: Plus this year's turnover up to the transition date.

subledger_only.title: Open invoices only
subledger_only.body: Customer and supplier balances; no general-ledger opening balances.

accounts.title: Chart of accounts
accounts.body: Bring your chart of accounts over if you used accounts of your own. If the old software had the usual Estonian chart, the Arvelo standard chart fits and you can skip this step.
accounts.export: Chart of accounts (Excel, CSV or PDF)
accounts.standardHint: The opening balance import creates missing accounts itself if the file has accounts that are not here.

balance.title: Opening balances
balance.body: Load last year's closing balance sheet. Balances are read from the file and mapped to Arvelo accounts; you review every line before confirming.
balance.bodyMidYear: Load last year's closing balance sheet and this year's turnover up to the transition date, so the whole year's turnover is in Arvelo and the annual report comes out right.
balance.exportBalance: Balance sheet (trial balance) at year end — Excel or PDF
balance.exportTurnover: Turnover from the start of the year to the transition date — Excel or PDF

openItems.title: Open invoices
openItems.body: Unpaid customer and supplier invoices come over per partner, so payments in the bank can be matched to them right away.
openItems.exportReceivables: Customer balances (unpaid invoices) per partner and invoice
openItems.exportPayables: Supplier balances (unpaid invoices) per partner and invoice
openItems.partnersHint: Partners are created by the balance import and completed from the business register.

bank.title: Bank
bank.body: Add the bank accounts and load the statement from the transition date on. You get it from the internet bank, not the old software.
bank.export: Bank statement from the transition date — camt.053 XML (recommended) or CSV, from the internet bank

control.title: Check and lock
control.body: Review the opening balances and lock them. Once locked they cannot be changed by accident.
control.bodyMidYear: Load the old software's balance sheet as of the transition date. Arvelo compares every account and shows the differences; when everything matches, lock the opening balances.
control.export: Balance sheet as of the transition date — Excel or PDF
control.lockedHint: Locking is the last step — until then you can re-import layers.

daily.title: Daily work
daily.body: Once the balances are in place, set up what saves manual work every day.

purchases.title: Purchase invoices
purchases.body: PDFs and e-invoices turn into drafts by themselves; the company can get its own e-mail address for invoices.

recurring.title: Recurring invoices
recurring.body: Monthly invoices are prepared and sent automatically.

team.title: Users
team.body: Invite the client's people to a view of only what concerns them.
